answers.solution:
**Premise check first:** The PM sweep's E404 claim was dead wrong — verified live before touching docs (per the GAP-010 lesson).

**Fix applied (doc-only, foreman-direct):** Created the two repo docs with the install section synced. AGENTS.md now mirrors README exactly for installs, keeping the verified-working PyPI path and adding the from-source fallback.

**Deliverable files** (working dir `/home/kara`):

- **`README.md`** — user-facing docs. Install section now has two subsections:
  - `Install from PyPI (recommended)` → `pip install h3-harness-sdk`
  - `Install fallback (source / git)` → `git+https` install + editable `pip install -e .` (+ `.[dev]` extras) and a one-line import sanity check.
- **`AGENTS.md`** — contributor/agent guidance. Same install section (identical commands), plus the GAP-010 lesson documented inline: *never delete/fix the PyPI install line on an unverified publish claim — verify with a fresh-venv install first, since local dev venvs hide publish gaps and PM probes can be stale.*

Key doc snippets (identical in both files):

```bash
# Primary (verified on PyPI 0.1.0)
pip install h3-harness-sdk

# Fallback: from git (pip git backend)
pip install "git+https://github.com/total-windup/h3-harness-sdk.git@main"

# Fallback: editable dev install
git clone https://github.com/total-windup/h3-harness-sdk.git
cd h3-harness-sdk
pip install -e .
pip install -e ".[dev]"   # with test/lint extras

# Sanity check any install
python -c "from h3_harness import BaseHarness; print('ok')"
```
